design_gotchas.title: VEN Must Never Exceed VIN + 0.3 V (Sequencing Trap vs TPS7A02/TLV755P)
design_gotchas.detail: Absolute Maximum Ratings Footnote (2) on Page 5 restricts VEN to the lesser of VIN + 0.3 V or 6 V. Driving EN from an always-on MCU rail while VIN is unpowered violates absolute maximum ratings and back-feeds internal ESD diodes — unlike TPS7A02, TPS7A20, and TLV755P which tolerate independent VEN up to 6.0–6.5 V.

design_gotchas.title: No Active Output Discharge and No Internal Reverse-Current Limiting
design_gotchas.detail: TLV70033DDCR lacks an internal output pulldown resistor when disabled (causing VOUT to coast down slowly under light load) and Section 7.3.1 warns that the PMOS body diode conducts unlimited reverse current if VOUT exceeds VIN (externally limit to <= 5% of rated 200 mA = 10 mA).

design_gotchas.title: DDC Thin SOT-23-5 Footprint Caution & High 235.9 C/W RθJA
design_gotchas.detail: DDC is TI's thin-profile SOT-23-5 (1.1 mm max height vs ~1.45 mm on DBV) with RθJA = 235.9 °C/W. Page 4 notes Pin 4 (NC) can be tied to GND to improve heat spreading, though doing so would short Pin 4 if a BYP/NR-pin LDO (e.g., AP2210K) were ever substituted on the same board.

design_gotchas.title: Requires >= 0.1 uF Effective Output Capacitance and ESR < 200 mOhm
design_gotchas.detail: While TLV700 tolerates heavy ceramic DC-bias derating down to 0.1 uF effective capacitance, TI cautions on Page 13 that a nominal 0.1 uF capacitor does not guarantee stability and recommends a 1 uF X5R/X7R ceramic capacitor with ESR < 200 mOhm.

typical_use_cases: Cost-sensitive 200 mA Bluetooth, ZigBee, and handheld RF/MCU 3.3 V rails with 68 dB PSRR
Ultra-low-height PCBs requiring thin-profile DDC SOT-23-5 (2.90 x 1.60 mm) and tiny ceramic output caps
Single-cell Li-Ion battery rails benefiting from 175 mV typical dropout at 200 mA and 31 uA no-load IQ
General-purpose 100 us fast-startup 3.3 V supplies when EN is tied to VIN or sequenced after VIN
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TLV70033DDCR is a 200 mA fixed 3.3 V (±2% over -40°C to +125°C) low-dropout regulator in a thin-profile 5-pin DDC SOT-23-5 package (1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN active high, 4=N/C, 5=OUT). Operating from 2.0 V to 5.5 V (6.0 V abs max), it delivers 175 mV typical dropout at 200 mA, 31 uA no-load IQ (270 uA at 200 mA), 1 uA shutdown current, 68 dB PSRR at 1 kHz, 48 uVRMS noise, and stability down to 0.1 uF effective ceramic capacitance (<200 mOhm ESR). Key gotchas include VEN <= VIN + 0.3 V abs max, no active output discharge, no reverse-current protection, and 235.9 °C/W RθJA.
